gloss: to build, to construct, to brew

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {造|つく}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to build, to construct, to manufacture
definitions.explanation: To create something large-scale such as buildings, ships, or infrastructure. Used for construction and large-scale manufacturing, as opposed to 作る which covers general making and creation.

definitions.gloss: to brew, to produce (alcohol, miso, etc.)
definitions.explanation: To produce fermented or brewed products such as sake, wine, beer, soy sauce, or miso. This is the standard kanji used for brewing and fermentation.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{造|つく}られた。

notes:
KANJI DISTINCTION:
Japanese has three kanji for つくる, each with a different scope:
- ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: general making, creating (food, art, documents, etc.) — the most common
- {造|つく}る: building, constructing, brewing — large-scale or industrial
- ⟦{創|つく}る→創る：30256_tsukuru⟧: creating something new, founding — emphasizes originality

In practice, ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ can be used for almost anything, while {造|つく}る is specifically chosen for construction (⟦{造船|ぞうせん}→造船：04484_zousen⟧, ⟦{建造|けんぞう}→建造：22998_kenzou⟧) and brewing (⟦{醸造|じょうぞう}→醸造：14438_jouzou⟧, ⟦{酒造|しゅぞう}→酒造：17111_shuzou⟧).

COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb, conjugates identically to ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{造|つく}る: to build a ship
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{造|つく}る: to brew sake
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{造|つく}る: to build a road
